sources.title: Green Party Manifesto 2024: Fairer, Greener Transport
sources.publisher: Green Party of England and Wales
sources.notes: 2024 general-election manifesto chapter on transport, the same manifesto as the other Green chapters used here. Retrieved 2026-09-29.

claims.claim_text: Labour's 2024 manifesto pledged to reform the railways and bring them into public ownership.
claims.source_quote: We will put passengers at the heart of the service by reforming the railways and bringing them into public ownership.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: Labour's 2024 manifesto pledged new powers for local leaders to franchise bus services and to lift the ban on councils owning bus companies.
claims.source_quote: Building on the work of Labour mayors, we will reform the broken system through new powers for local leaders to franchise local bus services, and we will lift the ban on municipal ownership.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: Labour's 2024 manifesto pledged to fix an extra one million potholes in England each year of the parliament, paid for by deferring the A27 bypass.
claims.source_quote: We will fix an additional one million potholes across England in each year of the next parliament, funded by deferring the A27 bypass, which is poor value for money.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: The Conservative Party's current plan says it would launch a national pothole taskforce with hundreds of specialist repair units and a national reporting platform.
claims.source_quote: Fix roads through a National Pothole Patrol – we will launch a national pothole taskforce, to deploy hundreds of specialist repair units, as well as national pothole reporting platform.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: The Conservative Party's current plan says it would end blanket 20mph limits and use them only where necessary.
claims.source_quote: We will end the blanket use of 20mph limits and only use when necessary.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: The Conservative Party's current plan says it would reverse the planned 5p rise in fuel duty.
claims.source_quote: Reverse Labour's planned 5p hike to fuel duty
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: The Green Party's 2024 manifesto pledged to raise public subsidy for rail and bus travel to £10bn a year by the end of the parliament, with free bus travel for under-18s.
claims.source_quote: Increase annual public subsidies for rail and bus travel to £10bn by the end of the next Parliament, with free bus travel for under-18s.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: The Green Party's 2024 manifesto pledged to bring the railways back into public ownership.
claims.source_quote: Bring the railways back into public ownership.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: The Green Party's 2024 manifesto pledged to ban domestic flights where the journey would take less than three hours by train.
claims.source_quote: A ban on domestic flights for journeys that would take less than three hours by train.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: Reform UK's 2024 manifesto pledged to legislate to ban ULEZ, Clean Air Zones and Low Traffic Neighbourhoods.
claims.source_quote: Legislate to ban ULEZ Clean Air Zones and Low Traffic Neighbourhoods.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: Reform UK's 2024 manifesto pledged to scrap the rest of HS2, which it says would save £25 billion.
claims.source_quote: Scrap HS2 Save £25 billion by scrapping the rest of this bloated vanity project.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: Reform UK's 2024 manifesto pledged to scrap 20mph zones except where safety is critical.
claims.source_quote: We will keep the speed limit low where safety is critical. Otherwise, 20 MPH zones will be scrapped.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: UKIP pledged to return all bus and cycle lanes to general traffic.
claims.source_quote: The Party will return to general use all bus and cycle lanes.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: UKIP pledged to remove all Low Emission and Ultra Low Emission Zones, and the planters and bollards that close streets to through traffic.
claims.source_quote: We will remove all Low Emission Zones, and Ultra Low Emission Zones, and remove planters and bollards which have turned streets into dead ends.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: UKIP pledged to raise the motorway speed limit to 85mph where road conditions and weather permit.
claims.source_quote: We propose to raise this limit on motorways to 85mph, where road conditions and weather permit.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: The Liberal Democrats' 2024 manifesto pledged to freeze rail fares and simplify ticketing on public transport.
claims.source_quote: Freeze rail fares and simplify ticketing on public transport to ensure regular users are paying fair and affordable prices.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: The Liberal Democrats' 2024 manifesto pledged more powers for councils to franchise bus services and simpler funding, so routes can be restored or added, especially in rural areas.
claims.source_quote: Boost bus services by giving local authorities more powers to franchise services and simplifying funding, so that bus routes can be restored or new routes added where there is local need, especially in rural areas.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: The Liberal Democrats' 2024 manifesto pledged half-price fares on buses, trams and trains for 18-year-olds.
claims.source_quote: Extending half-fares on buses, trams and trains to 18-year-olds.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: Rejoin EU says re-joining the EU and restoring free movement would cut queues at airports and ports and let the UK take part in European transport projects.
claims.source_quote: Re-joining the EU and restoring free movement would also cut queues at airports and ports by reducing or removing the need for border checks and enable the UK to participate in European-wide transport projects and networks.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: The Climate Party says it would invest in infrastructure for electric vehicles and smart grids, without giving figures.
claims.source_quote: Investment in critical infrastructure upgrades that support electric vehicles and smart grids will not only modernise our cities but also open up new markets for private investment in renewable energy infrastructure, smart city solutions, and associated industries.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: The Official Monster Raving Loony Party pledged an annual 'ROT' test to make sure all roads are car worthy.
claims.source_quote: We will introduce a ROT, an annual test to make sure all roads are car worthy.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: UK Voice says railways should stay largely private but with stronger regulation of prices.
claims.source_quote: Railways remain largely private but with stronger pricing regulation
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: Restore Britain says it would automate the London Underground, which it says would cut costs and end the effect of transport strikes.
claims.source_quote: Automation would cut costs, improve reliability, and ensure Londoners are never again held hostage by transport unions.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: Workers Party of Britain pledged to extend London's free public travel for children to the rest of the country, raising the age limit from 11 to 16.
claims.source_quote: first, we are committed to the extension of the free public travel arrangements for children from London to the rest of the country extending the current age restrictions from 11 to 16;
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: Workers Party of Britain lists universal access to a cheap or free integrated public transport system among its aims.
claims.source_quote: Universal access to a cheap or free fully-integrated public transport system and all essential amenities: water, sanitation, heating, electricity, post, telephone, internet.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: Christian Peoples Alliance pledged to oppose Ultra Low Emission Zones and similar schemes in town and city centres unless local communities expressly support them.
claims.source_quote: Oppose the introduction of Ultra Low Emission Zones, and other similar measures, in city and town centres, without the express democratic support of those local communities.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim)

claims.claim_text: Pledges to support public transport, cycle routes and sustainable investment in response to the climate emergency.
claims.source_quote: * to support public transport, cycle routes and sustainable investment to respond to the climate emergency
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim); statement checked live on Democracy Club, 29 Sept 2026

claims.claim_text: Says he would work to fix potholes around the village and improve the bus service, with evening and Sunday buses.
claims.source_quote: That means fixing the potholes in and around the village, fighting proposals for inappropriate development on green spaces, and improving our bus service, with evening and Sunday services.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim); statement checked live on Democracy Club, 29 Sept 2026

claims.claim_text: Says he would produce a community speed plan to make the village safer for children and older people.
claims.source_quote: It means producing a community speed plan to make our village safer for children and older people, and sorting the drainage issues which leave parts of the village vulnerable to flooding.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim); statement checked live on Democracy Club, 29 Sept 2026

claims.claim_text: Lists safer roads among her priorities for the council.
claims.source_quote: My priorities are to ensure the Council support economic recovery, delivering the basics better (including social care) and cutting waste, safer roads and safer, cleaner and greener communities.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim); statement checked live on Democracy Club, 29 Sept 2026

claims.claim_text: Says he will push Wiltshire Council to work with residents on rat-running, speeding and congestion in named Milford streets.
claims.source_quote: Too many roads in Milford are used as 'rat runs', with residents experiencing speeding, congestion and damage to cars. Mac and Lawrence will push Wiltshire Council to work with residents to find creative solutions to the problems in streets such as Rampart Road, Milford Mill Road, Wain-A-Long Road and the surrounding areas.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim); statement checked live on Democracy Club, 29 Sept 2026

claims.claim_text: Says he wants a fairer deal on the price of car parking in Salisbury.
claims.source_quote: I want to see justice for Salisbury which to me means as many decisions as possible about Salisbury being made here in Salisbury and a fairer deal on issues like the price of car parking.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim); statement checked live on Democracy Club, 29 Sept 2026

claims.claim_text: Says Yorkshire deserves world-class transport to create jobs and cut pollution.
claims.source_quote: Yorkshire deserves world-class transport to create jobs and cut pollution.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim); statement checked live on Democracy Club, 29 Sept 2026

claims.claim_text: Says she will work to improve road safety for pedestrians, cyclists and drivers.
claims.source_quote: **Improving road safety** – making our roads safer for pedestrians, cyclists and drivers.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim); statement checked live on Democracy Club, 29 Sept 2026

claims.claim_text: Says he wants to continue the Green administration's work on active and inclusive travel: walking, wheeling and cycling.
claims.source_quote: I’m keen to see a continuation of the current Green administration’s work on improving active and inclusive travel, especially walking and wheeling as well as cycling.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim); statement checked live on Democracy Club, 29 Sept 2026

claims.claim_text: Says he will secure extra investment for local roads.
claims.source_quote: I will protect our rural way of life – backing our farmers. And, I will secure extra investment for our local roads.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim); statement checked live on Democracy Club, 29 Sept 2026

claims.claim_text: Says bringing pothole repairs in-house and devolving them to the district council would give a more responsive service and end botched repairs.
claims.source_quote: With very high levels of council tax, huge savings cound be generated by using systems thinking approaches by bringing the pothole fixing team in-house, devolving it to our District Council would create a more responsive service and end the cycle of botched repairs.
claims.drafted_by: ai:claude (drafted from the published text; quote checked verbatim); statement checked live on Democracy Club, 29 Sept 2026
